**Day 1 – Sat 5 Dec:** Take train 17946 from Delhi at 09:30, arriving in Agra at 12:52. Visit Agra Fort from 13:30 to 15:30. Stay at Hotel Lotus Agra (H-AGRA-1), all three in one room.

**Day 2 – Sun 6 Dec:** Visit the Taj Mahal from 08:00 to 10:30. It's closed on Fridays, but Sunday is fine. Stay a second night at Hotel Lotus Agra.

**Day 3 – Mon 7 Dec:** Take train 13048 from Agra at 05:30, arriving in Jaipur at 09:26. The 06:15 train was waitlisted, so this is the only morning option. Then visit:
- Amber Fort, 10:00–12:30
- Hawa Mahal, 13:00–14:00
- City Palace, 14:30–16:30

Stay at Hotel Lotus Jaipur (H-JAIP-1), one room.

**Day 4 – Tue 8 Dec:** Take train 18348 from Jaipur at 16:30, arriving in Delhi at 21:52. Nothing is planned before the train, so the day is free.

| Item | Rs |
|---|---|
| Trains (all in the seated AC class) | 2,975 |
| Hotels (3 nights) | 3,110 |
| Sight tickets | 7,875 |
| Food allowance (Rs 300 per person per day at budget hotels) | 3,600 |
| **Total** | **≈17,560** |

I've planned your 7-day trip from Delhi to Jaipur and Udaipur for 20–26 Dec 2026. It comes to about Rs 33,860 for all 4 of you, well under your Rs 85,000 budget. The bookings are all made today, 15 Nov, and every train has confirmed seats.

**Day by day**
- **20 Dec:** Morning train from Delhi to Jaipur (CC class, 05:30, arriving 10:49). Visit Hawa Mahal (11:30–12:30), then City Palace (13:00–15:00). Overnight at Hotel Lotus Jaipur.
- **21 Dec:** Free day in Jaipur, same hotel.
- **22 Dec:** Morning train from Jaipur to Udaipur (CC class, 06:15, arriving 12:51). Visit City Palace Udaipur (13:30–15:30), then the Lake Pichola boat ride (16:00–17:00). Overnight at Hotel Courtyard Udaipur.
- **23–24 Dec:** Free days in Udaipur, same hotel.
- **25 Dec:** Overnight sleeper train from Udaipur to Delhi (SL class, 19:30).
- **26 Dec:** Arrive in Delhi at 08:33.

**Your grandparent's needs**
- **Stairs:** Neither hotel has a lift, but both have ground-floor rooms and serve vegetarian food. Make sure the grandparent's room is on the ground floor.
- **Lower berth:** The Udaipur–Delhi train has 4 lower berths free in sleeper class, so there is one for the grandparent. Sleeper is a non-AC class, and it was the only option with confirmed seats and a free lower berth. 3rd AC had seats but no lower berths, and the other classes and the later train were on waitlist or RAC (partly confirmed). There are no flights or road transfers from Udaipur to Delhi on these dates.
- **Amber Fort:** I left it out because it isn't wheelchair-accessible.

**Why the dates are set this way**
- You leave Jaipur on the 22nd because the 23rd's daytime trains were waitlisted or RAC.
- You leave Udaipur on the night of the 25th so you're back in Delhi on the 26th, your last day.

**Cost breakdown (Rs)**
- **Trains:** 6,040
- **Hotels:** 11,420 (Jaipur 4,560 + Udaipur 6,860, 2 rooms with 2 people each)
- **Sights:** 8,000
- **Food allowance:** 8,400

I've put together a 5-day plan for the 4 of you, Kochi → Munnar → Alleppey → Kochi, from 8 to 12 December 2026. It comes to about Rs 28,000 of your Rs 48,000. It uses step-free hotels and sights, and no road travel at night. Everything is priced as of today, 15 Nov 2026. Nothing is booked yet.

**Day by day**
- **Tue 8 Dec:** Fort Kochi walk, 08:00–10:00. Then a taxi to Munnar, 10:30 to 15:05. You stay 2 nights at Hotel Orchid Munnar (H-MUNN-1), which has ground-floor rooms.
- **Wed 9 Dec:** Tea Museum in Munnar, 10:00–11:15. The rest of the day is free.
- **Thu 10 Dec:** Taxi to Alleppey, 08:00 to 12:55. Houseboat evening cruise, 16:00–18:00 (free). You stay 2 nights at Hotel Sunrise Alleppey (H-ALLE-1), which has ground-floor rooms.
- **Fri 11 Dec:** Backwater cruise, 09:00–12:00.
- **Sat 12 Dec:** Taxi back to Kochi, 10:00 to 11:24. Kathakali show, 18:00–19:30.

There are 2 rooms in each hotel, with 2 guests per room. One 4-seat taxi does each trip.

**Cost (approximate)**
| Item | Rs |
|---|---|
| Taxis (3 trips) | 8,275 |
| Munnar hotel (2 nights, 2 rooms) | 4,140 |
| Alleppey hotel (2 nights, 2 rooms) | 4,690 |
| Food (Rs 300 per person per day) | 6,000 |
| Tea Museum, backwater cruise and Kathakali tickets | 4,900 |
| **Total** | **about 28,005** |

**Things to know**
- I left out Eravikulam viewpoint in Munnar because it isn't wheelchair-accessible.
- Neither hotel has a lift. Please ask for ground-floor rooms when you book.
- The two taxi rides through the hills take about 4½–5 hours each.
- No hotel is booked for the night of 12 December in Kochi, since the trip ends that day.

I've submitted a 4-day plan for 2 adults, Mumbai to Kerala and back, for about Rs 26,700, under your Rs 30,000 budget. It includes one hotel night. Two things to know first:

- **You spend two nights on the train.** The Kochi–Mumbai train takes almost 26 hours. To get back to Mumbai by the last day (7 Jan), you have to leave Kochi on the evening of 5 Jan. So all the sightseeing fits into the first two days, and 6 Jan is spent on the train.
- **Day 2 is long.** It has nearly 6½ hours of road travel. I used private taxis rather than buses because the bus times (08:00 and 21:30) don't fit around the sights. The Munnar hill roads are closed 20:00–05:00 in winter, but both hill drives finish in daylight.

**Day 1 – Mon 4 Jan**
- Flight IX126, Mumbai 06:10 → Kochi 08:50
- Fort Kochi walk, 09:20–11:20 (free)
- Taxi Kochi → Munnar, 11:50 → 16:25
- Night at Hotel Orchid Munnar (H-MUNN-1), 1 room

**Day 2 – Tue 5 Jan**
- Eravikulam viewpoint, Munnar, 08:00–10:30
- Taxi Munnar → Alleppey, 11:00 → 15:55
- Houseboat evening cruise, Alleppey, 16:25–18:25 (free)
- Taxi Alleppey → Kochi, 18:55 → 20:19
- Train 14358 Kochi → Mumbai, leaves 22:40, 3rd-class AC sleeper (3A), General quota. 17 seats were available when I checked.

**Days 3–4 – 6 and 7 Jan:** on the train, arriving in Mumbai at 00:32 on 7 Jan.

**Cost estimate**

| Item | Rs |
|---|---|
| Flights (2 × 5,085) | 10,170 |
| Taxis (3,350 + 3,565 + 1,360) | 8,275 |
| Train, 3A (2 × 2,205) | 4,410 |
| Food allowance (Rs 300 per person per day, set by the hotel's price level) | 2,400 |
| Hotel, 1 night | 1,070 |
| Eravikulam tickets | 400 |
| **Total** | **about 26,725** |

**Rough costs:**
- **Hotels:** Rs 6,025 for 4 nights, one room for all 3 of you each night. If the peak-season +40% is charged on top of the listed rates, that rises to about Rs 8,400. The rates don't say whether the surcharge is already included.
- **Taxis:** Rs 8,275 for one car on all three drives.
- **Tickets:** Rs 2,850. Your child goes free because they're under 5.
- **Food allowance:** Rs 3,000–4,500, depending on whether the child is counted.

**Notes:**
- **No trains:** every leg is by road, so the rule about your child not getting a berth doesn't come into play.
- **Hill-road hours:** both Munnar drives leave at 07:00 and arrive before noon. Hill roads are closed from 20:00 to 05:00 at this time of year, so they're well clear of that.
- **Stairs:** the Kochi and Alleppey hotels have no lift, and the Alleppey one has no ground-floor rooms. That's worth knowing if you're carrying a toddler and bags.
- **Upgrades:** with this much budget left, you could swap the Alleppey hotel for a houseboat. The cheapest is Rs 7,955 for the night. You could also choose better hotels and still stay within budget.

I've planned the 6-day trip for 4 adults and submitted it. It comes to about Rs 47,500 if the 40% peak surcharge is added on top of the listed hotel rates, which leaves about Rs 12,500 of your Rs 60,000. I couldn't tell from the hotel listings whether their prices already include the surcharge. If they do, the total is about Rs 42,800. You'll book the taxis and hotels today, 15 Nov 2026. No train runs on any of these routes, so every leg is a 4-seat taxi. All drives are in daylight, inside the hours hill roads are open (05:00 to 20:00 in winter).

**The trip**
- **Sat 26 Dec:** Taxi from Chandigarh at 08:00, reaching Shimla at 12:05. Walk The Ridge and Mall Road from 12:35 to 14:35 (free). Night at Hotel Sunrise Shimla (H-SHIM-2).
- **Sun 27 Dec:** Kufri from 10:00 to 13:00. Second night at Hotel Sunrise Shimla.
- **Mon 28 Dec:** Taxi from Shimla at 06:00, reaching Manali at 14:35. Night at Hotel Riverview Manali (H-MANA-1).
- **Tue 29 Dec:** Solang Valley from 10:00 to 13:00, then Hadimba Temple from 14:00 to 15:00 (free). Night in Manali.
- **Wed 30 Dec:** Free day with nothing booked. Night in Manali.
- **Thu 31 Dec:** Taxi from Manali at 07:00, back in Chandigarh at 17:15.

**Rooms:** Two rooms of 2 guests each at both hotels. Both are basic, and neither has a lift.

**Costs**
| Item | Cost (Rs) |
|---|---|
| Shimla hotel, 2 nights, 2 rooms | 7,952 (5,680 before surcharge) |
| Manali hotel, 3 nights, 2 rooms | 14,742 (10,530 before surcharge) |
| Taxis (3,025 + 5,940 + 7,020) | 15,985 |
| Sights (Kufri 400, Solang Valley 1,200) | 1,600 |
| Food allowance (Rs 300 per person per day) | 7,200 |
| **Total** | **about 47,480** |

The two long drives are tiring: Shimla to Manali takes about 8.5 hours and Manali to Chandigarh about 10. If you want to cut costs, there's a bus on both routes for Rs 650 or 780 per person. But its evening departure (21:30) would break the night road closure, so only the 08:00 bus works, and it takes 1.5 to 2 hours longer.

I've built a plan for the 5-day trip and submitted it. It comes to roughly Rs 17,000 against your Rs 45,000 budget, and every train leg has confirmed seats. There's one thing to know first: because of sold-out trains, you leave Lucknow on the night of 30 Dec and reach Delhi at 10:05 on 31 Dec. The 31 Dec train and the only Lucknow–Delhi day train were all waitlisted, and there are no flights that day.

**Day by day**
- **27 Dec:** Overnight train 15182 from Delhi at 21:15, in 2A (two-tier AC). The more common 3A class was waitlisted on both trains, and the cheaper sleeper class had only 1 seat.
- **28 Dec:** You reach Varanasi at 15:32. Ganga Aarti 18:30–19:45. Night at Hotel Lotus Varanasi (H-VARA-1).
- **29 Dec:** Kashi Vishwanath darshan 06:00–07:30 (the temple is open 05:00–12:00). Train 15313 to Ayodhya, 13:10–16:56. Hanuman Garhi 17:30–18:15. Night at Hotel Courtyard Ayodhya (H-AYOD-1).
- **30 Dec:** Ram Mandir darshan 07:00–09:00 (the temple is open 07:00–11:30). The Ayodhya–Lucknow train was on the RAC list, which doesn't count as a confirmed seat, so you take a taxi at 09:45 instead (Rs 2,560), arriving 12:35. Bara Imambara 13:15–14:45. Overnight train 15234 in sleeper class leaves Lucknow at 23:20.
- **31 Dec:** You arrive in Delhi at 10:05.

**Costs**
- **Tickets:** All trains are general quota booked today (15 Nov), with no Tatkal, so nobody needs to give an Aadhaar OTP. Your child is on a half-fare ticket with no berth of their own.
- **Hotels:** These are the cheapest rooms, one room for all 3 of you. I haven't confirmed whether the listed rates already include the 40% peak surcharge (24 Dec–2 Jan). I allowed for it either way when working out the estimate.
- **Temples:** Both darshans and the Ganga Aarti are free. Bara Imambara costs Rs 300 per adult and half for your child.

**Gaps**
- **Lucknow:** You don't stay a night there, but you do visit it.
- **Sarnath:** It's left out to keep the Varanasi schedule easy.

**Day by day:**
- **Mon 14 Jun:** Fly Delhi to Leh on IX755 (09:20–11:04). Rest for the day to get used to the altitude. Night at Hotel Grand Leh.
- **Tue 15 Jun:** Shanti Stupa (08:00–09:00), then Leh Palace (10:00–11:30). Night at Hotel Grand Leh.
- **Wed 16 Jun:** Taxi from Leh to Nubra (07:00–11:15). Diskit Monastery and Hunder dunes (11:45–15:45), with the protected-area fee paid. Night at Hotel Grand Nubra.
- **Thu 17 Jun:** Taxi from Nubra back to Leh (08:00–12:15). Night at Hotel Grand Leh.
- **Fri 18 Jun:** Taxi from Leh to Pangong (06:00–11:35). Pangong Lake (12:05–16:05), with the fee paid. Night at Hotel Residency Pangong.
- **Sat 19 Jun:** Taxi from Pangong back to Leh (08:00–13:35). Night at Hotel Grand Leh.
- **Sun 20 Jun:** Fly Leh to Delhi on IX191 (13:20–15:04).

I've planned and submitted your 8-day trip for 3 adults, 5–12 July 2027. It comes to about Rs 66,100, well under your Rs 120,000 budget. There are no flights or road transfers straight from Delhi to Manali, so you go by road through Chandigarh (one night there).

**Day by day**
| Date | Travel | Sights | Night |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mon 5 Jul | Taxi Delhi → Chandigarh, 08:00–12:57 | — | Hotel Courtyard Chandigarh |
| Tue 6 Jul | Taxi Chandigarh → Manali, 07:00–17:15 | — | Hotel Riverview Manali |
| Wed 7 Jul | Taxi Manali → Leh, 05:00–21:15 (about 16 hours) | Rest day for the altitude | Hotel Grand Leh |
| Thu 8 Jul | — | Leh Palace 10:00–11:30; Shanti Stupa 16:00–17:00 | Hotel Grand Leh |
| Fri 9 Jul | Taxi Leh → Nubra, 07:00–11:15 | Diskit Monastery and Hunder dunes 11:45–15:45 | Hotel Grand Nubra |
| Sat 10 Jul | Taxi Nubra → Pangong, 05:30–12:25 | Pangong Lake 12:55–16:55 | Hotel Residency Pangong |
| Sun 11 Jul | Taxi Pangong → Leh, 08:00–13:35 | — | Hotel Grand Leh |
| Mon 12 Jul | Flight IX398 Leh → Delhi, 06:10–07:54 | — | Home |

- **Taxis:** each road leg uses one 4-seat taxi for all three of you.
- **Rooms:** every night is one room for 3 guests, in the cheapest hotels.
- **Altitude:** you don't go above Leh's height until Pangong on day 6.
- **Fees:** the Ladakh environment and Red Cross fee (Rs 400 each) is marked as paid for the Nubra and Pangong visits.

**Cost breakdown**
| Item | Rs |
|---|---|
| Taxis | 34,235 |
| Hotels (7 nights) | 9,260 |
| Flight (3 × 3,840) | 11,520 |
| Leh Palace tickets | 600 |
| Diskit tickets | 900 |
| Ladakh area fees (Nubra and Pangong) | 2,400 |
| Food (Rs 300 per person per day) | 7,200 |
| **Total** | **about 66,100** |

**Things to know**
- **Long drive on 7 July:** the Manali–Leh day is about 16 hours on the road.
- **Early flight home:** IX398 leaves Leh at 06:10. There are later flights at 13:20 (Rs 4,640 each) and 20:40 (Rs 4,430 each) if you'd prefer one.
- **Your money to spare:** the cheapest hotels and food rate leave about Rs 54,000 of your budget unused, so you could choose nicer hotels.
- **Train option skipped:** the Delhi–Chandigarh train can't be booked yet (bookings open 60 days ahead), so I used a taxi.

I've planned the 7 days at about Rs 56,660, well within your Rs 90,000 budget. The plan is submitted. The trip follows the altitude rules: your arrival day in Leh is rest only, and you don't go higher than Leh until day 3.

**Day by day**
- **Mon 28 Jun:** Fly Delhi to Leh on IX755 (09:20 to 11:04). Rest the whole day. You stay at Hotel Grand Leh (H-LEH-1) in one room for 3.
- **Tue 29 Jun:** Leh Palace from 10:00 to 11:30, then Shanti Stupa from 16:00 to 17:00. Second night at Hotel Grand Leh.
- **Wed 30 Jun:** Private taxi from Leh to Nubra, 07:00 to 11:15. Visit Diskit Monastery and the Hunder dunes from 11:45 to 15:45. You stay at Hotel Grand Nubra (H-NUBR-1).
- **Thu 1 Jul:** Taxi from Nubra to Pangong, 08:00 to 14:55. No sightseeing that afternoon. You stay at Hotel Residency Pangong (H-PANG-2).
- **Fri 2 Jul:** Pangong Lake from 07:00 to 11:00. Taxi back to Leh, 11:30 to 17:05. You stay at Hotel Grand Leh.
- **Sat 3 Jul:** A free day to rest in Leh at Hotel Grand Leh.
- **Sun 4 Jul:** Fly Leh to Delhi on IX191 (13:20 to 15:04).

**Before you go**
- **Ladakh fee:** Nubra and Pangong both need the Ladakh environment and Red Cross fee of Rs 400 per person. You pay it when you register before the visit. The plan counts it for both places.
- **No stairs-free rooms:** The Nubra and Pangong hotels have no lift, and the Pangong one has no ground-floor rooms. Neither sight is wheelchair accessible.

I've planned the 5-day trip for 2 adults. It should cost about Rs 23,000, well under your Rs 42,000 budget. Nothing is booked yet. Every leg is a private taxi (4 seats, 1 vehicle), and all drives are in daylight because hill roads close 20:00–05:00 in winter.

- **Mon 7 Dec:** Taxi from Guwahati at 08:00, reaching Shillong at 11:35. Visit Umiam Lake from 12:30 to 14:00. Stay at Hotel Haveli Shillong (H-SHIL-1), one room.
- **Tue 8 Dec:** Cherrapunji day trip from 09:00 to 14:00. Second night at the same hotel.
- **Wed 9 Dec:** Taxi from Shillong at 06:00, reaching Kaziranga at 14:35 (about 8½ hours on the road). Stay at Hotel Courtyard Kaziranga (H-KAZI-2), one room.
- **Thu 10 Dec:** Kaziranga Jeep Safari from 09:00 to 12:00. Second night at the same hotel.
- **Fri 11 Dec:** Taxi from Kaziranga at 08:00, back in Guwahati at 11:54.

| Item | Cost (Rs) |
|---|---|
| Taxis (2,700 + 5,940 + 3,440) | 12,080 |
| Hotels (4 nights, budget tier) | 3,735 |
| Entry fees (Umiam Lake, Cherrapunji, jeep safari) | 4,200 |
| Food allowance (Rs 300 per person per day) | 3,000 |
| **Total** | **about 23,015** |

The safari is in season (November to April) and open every day. With over Rs 18,000 left, you could add the Kaziranga Elephant Safari (Rs 2,600 for two, 05:30–07:30) or upgrade the hotels. Neither is in the plan yet.

I've put together a 5-day plan for 3 adults. It comes to about Rs 15,180 against your Rs 18,000 budget and has been submitted. The one thing missing is a safari at Kaziranga, because neither would fit in the budget.

**Day 1 – Tue 15 Dec:** Taxi from Guwahati to Shillong, leaving 08:00 and arriving 11:35 (one car, Rs 2,700). Umiam Lake from 12:05 to 13:35. Night at Hotel Palm Shillong (H-SHIL-2), one room for 3.
**Day 2 – Wed 16 Dec:** Cherrapunji day trip from 09:00 to 14:00. Second night at the same hotel.
**Day 3 – Thu 17 Dec:** Bus from Shillong to Kaziranga, leaving 08:00 and arriving 17:56. It's a long, full travel day. Night at Hotel Courtyard Kaziranga (H-KAZI-2), one room for 3.
**Day 4 – Fri 18 Dec:** Free day at Kaziranga. Second night at the same hotel.
**Day 5 – Sat 19 Dec:** Bus from Kaziranga to Guwahati, leaving 08:00 and arriving 12:51.

**Cost breakdown (Rs):**
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Taxi to Shillong | 2,700 |
| Bus to Kaziranga | 1,950 |
| Bus back to Guwahati | 1,260 |
| Hotels (4 nights, both budget tier) | 3,870 |
| Umiam Lake and Cherrapunji tickets | 900 |
| Food allowance (Rs 300 per person per day for budget hotels, 5 days) | 4,500 |
| **Total** | **about 15,180** |

- **Jeep safari:** Rs 1,800 per person, Rs 5,400 for 3. The total would be about Rs 20,580.
- **Elephant safari:** Rs 1,300 per person, Rs 3,900 for 3. The total would be about Rs 19,080, and it only runs 05:30 to 07:30.

If you can stretch the budget by about Rs 1,100, the elephant safari on Day 4 is the cheaper of the two to add.

**Booking notes:**
- There are no trains in this plan.
- The two hotels are basic: neither has a lift and neither has ground-floor rooms.
- The Shillong–Kaziranga road is a hill road, which is closed from 20:00 to 05:00 in winter. The 08:00 bus is the only option that day that runs within those hours.

R-AVAIL every train leg is confirmed (AVL with enough seats); RAC and waitlist do not count. R-OPEN sights on open days, within hours, for their full visit length.
R-SEASON sights in season and seasonal roads open. R-REST rest days (no leg over 2 hours, no ticketed sight). R-OCC rooms hold at most 3 guests and cover everyone; every leg is ticketed for exactly the right people.
R-BUD total cost within budget (the grader recomputes it from the tool prices; food allowance per person per day is 300 / 600 / 1000 by hotel tier, 800 on a houseboat).
R-DIET veg/jain/satvik hotels. R-ACC no_stairs hotels and sights; seniors need a free lower berth in sleeper/3A/2A. R-NIGHT no road legs in the night window (the task may set one; hill roads also close 20:00-05:00 from November to March). R-HRS travel hours per day.
R-ALT altitude pacing (the day you reach Leh is rest only; nothing higher than Leh, here above 3,500 m, before day 3). R-PERMIT Nubra and Pangong need the Ladakh environment + Red Cross fee paid (fee_paid true). R-ROUTE the trip does what was asked: every named city gets a night or a sight there (arriving is enough in the city where the trip ends).

Aapka Goa trip plan taiyaar hai: 3 log, 4–6 Dec, aana-jaana dono train se, Sleeper class (SL), General quota. Dono trains me abhi seats confirmed available hain. Kuch baatein pehle jaan lijiye:

- **Goa me hotel nahi hai.** Dono raatein train me guzarti hain, isliye hotel ki zaroorat nahi padti. Goa me aap 5 Dec ko subah 7:01 se raat 9:15 tak, lagbhag ek poora din, rahenge.
- **6 Dec ko Goa me rukne ka option nahi mila.** 6 Dec ki Intercity me 2S class me pakki seat nahi hai (RAC hai). CC class me sirf 2 seats hain, jabki chahiye 3. Tatkal ke liye har yatri ko booking ke time Aadhaar OTP dena padta hai, jo main akele nahi kar sakta. 5 Dec ki 7:30 PM wali train waitlist par hai.
- **Kharcha lagbhag ₹5,160:** train ₹2,310, Fort Aguada ticket ₹150, khaana ₹2,700 (₹300 per person per day). Ye ₹14,000 ke budget me aaram se hai.

**4 Dec (Shukr):** Bengaluru se Goa, train 13058, raat 7:30 baje nikalti hai aur 5 Dec subah 7:01 pahunchti hai.

**5 Dec (Shani) – Goa:**
- Basilica of Bom Jesus, 9:00–10:00 (free)
- Fort Aguada, 10:30–11:30 (₹50 per person)
- Baaki din khaali hai, apne hisaab se Goa ghoomiye.
- Wapsi: train 13878, raat 9:15 baje nikalti hai aur 6 Dec subah 10:02 Bengaluru pahunchti hai.

**6 Dec (Ravi):** Subah Bengaluru wapas.

Booking aaj (15 Nov) ki maani gayi hai.

मैंने प्लान जमा कर दिया है। इसकी अनुमानित लागत ₹21,820 है, जो ₹28,000 के बजट के अंदर है। सारी ट्रेन बुकिंग आज (15 नवंबर 2026) सामान्य कोटा में होगी।

**18 दिसंबर (शुक्रवार): दिल्ली से वाराणसी**
- ट्रेन 12733 इंटरसिटी, सुबह 09:30 बजे चलकर रात 23:37 पर वाराणसी पहुँचती है।
- सेकंड सिटिंग (2S) में 4 यात्रियों के लिए सीटें खाली हैं।
- AC चेयर कार (CC) में वेटिंग लिस्ट है, इसलिए वह कन्फ़र्म नहीं हो सकती थी।
- इसी तारीख की रात वाली ट्रेन में भी जगह थी, पर उससे आप 19 दिसंबर को दोपहर 3:17 बजे पहुँचते और वाराणसी में घूमने का पूरा दिन नहीं बचता।
- **ध्यान दें:** यह सफ़र लगभग 14 घंटे का है और 2S में बिना AC की साधारण सीटें होती हैं। बुजुर्गों के लिए यह थका देने वाला हो सकता है।
- **आरामदायक विकल्प:** सुबह 06:10 की फ़्लाइट IX783 (₹4,390 प्रति व्यक्ति), जो 08:03 पर पहुँचती है। इससे लागत लगभग ₹16,000 बढ़कर करीब ₹38,000 हो जाएगी, यानी बजट से बाहर। जमा किए गए प्लान में ट्रेन ही रखी है।
- रात: होटल रेज़िडेंसी वाराणसी (H-VARA-4), 2-2 लोगों के दो कमरे। इसमें लिफ्ट है और सात्विक खाना मिलता है।

**19 दिसंबर (शनिवार): वाराणसी दर्शन**
- काशी विश्वनाथ दर्शन: सुबह 09:00 से 10:30 तक, कोई टिकट नहीं।
- सारनाथ: 11:30 से 13:30 तक, टिकट ₹200 प्रति व्यक्ति।
- गंगा आरती: शाम 18:30 से 19:45 तक, कोई टिकट नहीं।
- तीनों जगह व्हीलचेयर से जाया जा सकता है।
- रात: उसी होटल में।

**20 दिसंबर (रविवार): वाराणसी से दिल्ली**
- ट्रेन 13885 इंटरसिटी, सुबह 06:15 बजे चलकर रात 20:29 पर दिल्ली पहुँचती है।
- AC चेयर कार (CC) में 4 यात्रियों के लिए सीटें खाली हैं।

**लागत का हिसाब**

| मद | राशि |
|---|---|
| ट्रेन | ₹6,160 |
| होटल (2 कमरे, 2 रातें) | ₹7,660 |
| खाना (₹600 प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति दिन, 3 दिन) | ₹7,200 |
| सारनाथ टिकट | ₹800 |
| **कुल** | **₹21,820** |

वाराणसी के अंदर आने-जाने (जैसे होटल से सारनाथ) का खर्च इसमें शामिल नहीं है।
